verdicts.rationale: The claimed defect (group search with strictGroupSize=true returning 15 results instead of limiting to 2) is FALSE_POSITIVE. Source code analysis reveals groupSize parameter controls results per group, not total results. Proto definition comment explicitly states 'StrictGroupSize means if the group size is less than groupSize, return error instead of returning results less than groupSize'. Live reproduction confirms expected behavior: with 5 cat values and groupSize=2, returning 15 results (5 groups × 2 results per group × 5 cat values) is correct group search semantics.
